programs.description: Police Inspector Kapil Khanna realises that his baby boy has been switched with a girl child by the hospital and files a lawsuit against the owner, Robert Decosta, while trying to find his missing son.
Twins Amit and Kishan are separated at birth. However, when their paths cross in the future, together they work their way through and strive to overcome challenges.
After losing his job owing to his arrogance and subsequently his son, Vijay, Atmaram realises his mistake and decides to turn over a new leaf.
Shyam, a middle-class man, falls in love with a millionaire's daughter and marries her. However, as their relationship starts deteriorating, Shyam finds solace in the company of Radha.
Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.
Vijay and Ajay make a living by stealing money from people. Their friendship is affected when Vijay discovers that Ajay's father may have been his father's killer.
After his lookalike, Ranjith, convinces Bhola to impersonate him for money, an innocent Bhola soon finds himself in trouble when the police chase after him for Ranjith's crimes.
Talented sisters, Sita and Lata, are renowned performing artists. However, the rivalry between them leads to a competition with far-reaching consequences.
Veeru and Dheeru live under the tyrant ruler, Raja Jaichand. Later, they embark on a mission and strive to overcome challenges to defeat the dictator.
Three brothers, each raised in different religious households, reunite after many years in a chance encounter. They set out to take revenge on those responsible for separating them.
A wife embraces her husband's illegitimate son as her own in honour of the other woman's memory. However, as time progresses, this starts to seem like a big mistake.

A man falls victim to a tragic twist of fate, enduring an imprisonment and bearing the weight of his consequences for the rest of his life.
A casino owner is trapped by a gangster and forced to work for him. However, when he refuses to kill a commissioner, the gangster abducts his secretary and sister to blackmail him.
Anand, a rich youngster, denounces his wealth to establish himself independently. However, he keeps struggling in the big city until Renu, a middle-class woman, helps him, and he falls for her.
A poet falls in love with a girl and later realises that she is terminally ill. Despite being aware of her condition, he decides to marry her and keep her happy.
After a journalist helps to release him from prison, a man agrees to work as a hitman for her, leading him to entangle with a battle between two drug lords.
Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.
When Amba Prasad realises the harsh truth that his relatives just care for his money, he leaves home. Upon reaching a village, he meets Arun and Aarti and his life changes forever.
Kishan, a dairy farmer, and Kabir, his brother, run into trouble when a local promoter decides to take over their land. When a corrupt inspector plays his part and kills Kabir, Kishan vows vengeance.
Raju and Madhu are forced apart by the latter's elder brothers, leading to increased distance between the two.
Born out of wedlock, Vijay grows up with deep resentment towards his biological father Raj, a wealthy industrialist who has been leading a comfortable life with his legitimate family in the big city.

While filming a documentary in a prison, Chandrika comes across three unique stories and, somewhere in between, finds what her heart has been seeking.
India 1974; Thriller; Dir. Ravi Tandon; Cast: Amitabh Bachchan, Parveen Babi. Ravi leads a good life with his mother & sister. When he learns that he is ill, he falsely takes the blame for a murder.
Two siblings drift apart after one of them disapproves of the other's blooming romance with an unknown woman. Eventually, fate reunites them under unexpected circumstances.

India 1979; Romance; Dir. Basu Bhattacharya; Cast: Sanjeev Kumar, Sharmila Tagore. Amar and Mansi have an arranged marriage. Amar falls in love with another woman and asks Mansi for a divorce. She agrees to do so only if he lets her meet the other woman.
The parents of an adopted child face issues of love, betrayal and custody when their daughter's birth mother arrives.
Vicky plans to marry Aarti, but his dreams are crushed when an incident causes her to lose her life. Fuelled by revenge, Vicky finds himself going down a dark path.
A widowed man and woman face abuse from their respective children and seek comfort from each other instead.
Sagar sets out to exact revenge against Dr Narendra, a smuggler who killed his father. But Sagar is soon framed for the murder of a woman and sent to jail.
Rahul falls in love with Sandhya, a fellow college student, but realises that she does not reciprocate his feelings. Undeterred by her rejection, he still pursues her but pays a huge price for it.

India 1982; Romance; Dir. Sai Paranjpye; Cast: Farooq Shaikh, Naseeruddin Shah, Deepti Naval. Rajaram, a middle-class clerk, is secretly in love with his neighbour, Sandhya, but is too shy to disclose his love. He is shocked when his smooth-talking friend comes visiting and soon woos Sandhya.

Shanti and Suraj lead a content life until he abandons her to marry Ruchi. Shanti and Ruchi both give birth to boys, who grow up and fight each other, unaware that they are half-brothers.
A slum-dwelling performer finds a new calling as a rising disco star. However, things take an unfortunate turn when an enemy from the past reappears in his life.
Vikram and Pratap, two young friends, live harmoniously. However, things get complicated when Pratap's sister is raped and murdered, and Pratap sets out to exact revenge.
Vishwanath, an honest lawyer, is framed and imprisoned due to a gangster. After his release, he sets out to seek revenge and ends up becoming a criminal.
Rajkumar's mother sets out to oppose his marriage after she finds out that he plans to marry the rival kingdom's princess.
An aspiring screenwriter becomes involved in a diamond heist while writing a script for his film and struggles to evade the police.
Aslam, a villager who runs a small business, accidentally meets the Prime Minister of India, who grants him special security on his request. Soon, he starts chasing political ambitions.
Tony, a burglar, comes under the radar of suspicion when a series of mysterious thefts bewilder the police. Soon enough, he tries to redeem his honour by going after the real criminal.
Jaswant is arrested and tortured for a crime he did not commit. On seeing his friend's condition, Kripal joins an extremist group in order to bring down the government.
Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

Anwar, a Muslim boy, falls in love with a Hindu girl who rejects him and elopes with his best friend. Post her death, a misunderstanding leads the police to believe that he is a terrorist.
Three roommates decide to solve their financial struggles by going down the path of crime and kidnapping people for small ransoms.
Ruby ventures into the forest searching for a legendary tribe but encounters Tarzan and falls for him. However, her father and fiancé plot to capture him and sell him to the circus.
Prem Mehra loses everything after one of his employees joins hands with his rapacious rival and the two plot against him. Later, his sons work together to retrieve their family's lost wealth.
Kalpana, a habitual liar, attempts to sabotage her sister's arranged marriage to a doctor, but complications arise when she develops feelings for him.
Sangeeta, a young woman, decides to sacrifice her dreams and work relentlessly to provide for her family after her father abandons them.

Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.
When Anoop ditches Mangala, she is forced to marry Anand, a blind singer. After seeing Anand's care, she falls for him, but things get complicated when Anoop re-enters the frame.

Amit wants to marry a modern woman, but his parents get him married to a village girl, Madhuri. When Amit refuses to accept her as his wife, Madhuri reinvents herself as Malathi and re-enters his life.
Despite loving Radha, Shyam marries Rukmini to respect his late father's wish. Things take a shocking turn when Shyam finds out that Radha gave birth to his illegitimate daughter, Dolly.
Subir, a singer, encourages his wife, Uma, to pursue a singing career. However, things take a turn when she becomes more popular than him.

Jay, an expert in gambling, works for a criminal unaware that he is being used to gain military secrets. When the police discover this, they assign Inspector Vijay, Jay's lookalike, to stop him.
Falsely accused of robbery and sent to prison for 12 years, a bank manager realises upon his return that a person whom he trusted had betrayed him.
Pehlwaan, a criminal, narrowly escapes a police encounter and uses a holy man's guise to hide. Though he soon amasses many followers, he continues to carry out his illegal activities.

programs.showName: Deewaar: Let's Bring Our Heroes Home
programs.description: Haunted by the past, Vijay turns to crime, while Ravi, his younger brother, becomes an honest police officer. Fate pits them against each other when Ravi is sent to nab Vijay.
Arjun, a youngster, works at a hotel owned by Raja and serves him faithfully. However, when he learns about a plot to kill Raja, he decides to save him from harm at any cost.

Kallu's life changes after his brother, Shamu, meets with an accident and requires money for his treatment. As a result, he is forced to rob Shamu's employer but gets arrested instead.
Three brothers, each raised in different religious households, reunite after many years in a chance encounter. They set out to take revenge on those responsible for separating them.
Asha is impregnated by one of the three men she has an affair with. She moves to Mauritius with her daughter to start a new life, but her past soon comes back to haunt her.
Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.
Radhe looks up to Kadak Singh, a local politician, but holds a grudge against his partner, Ram Tripathi. However, things reach a boiling point when Tripathi sets his sights on Radhe's wife, Lalli.
A young man stumbles upon a mysterious woman, who he suspects of being a ghost. However, his worst fears come true when his mother arranges his marriage with the same woman.
Sunderlal and Farooq befriend each other in odd circumstances, but when they meet wealthy Pestonji, they hatch a cunning plan to use him to escape their money troubles.
Rajesh, the superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend, Shekar, in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler, who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.
Two struggling actors from Punjab who have the same name, Balwinder Singh, come to Mumbai and fall in love with the same woman.
A devout Muslim Indian man is tasked with repairing a lorry in order to transport the ashes of Mahatma Gandhi. However, when communal violence strikes, he is left with a troubling dilemma.

Brothers Prem, Vijay and Ravi are happy, but their lives change when Prem gets killed. Ravi must save his family from an evil man, Dharampal, while Vijay is preoccupied with Sapna.
NRI Shyam comes to India to fulfil the final wish of his late mother who wanted him to marry an Indian girl. Unbeknownst to him, the girl he falls in love with is a pawn in the hands of his enemies.
Kailash's uncle discovers a formula to save energy, which could make him very wealthy. Mr Mehta, an industrialist, envies his success and devises an evil plan to steal the formula.

After returning to his village, Ravi learns that the local farmers are being oppressed by a despotic landlord. Soon, he decides to contest the panchayat elections against the tyrant and put an end to his cruel rule.
Raj is hired as a bodyguard for Komal, and the two grow closer to each other over time. However, things get complicated when he comes across Nihal, the man who molested his sister.
When Amba Prasad realises the harsh truth that his relatives just care for his money, he leaves home. Upon reaching a village, he meets Arun and Aarti and his life changes forever.
After the murder of millionaire Ranjit Rai, his mistress Radha is apprehended by the police. Journalist Rakesh teams up with his friends and a skilled defence lawyer to uncover the truth.
Vipul and Saurabh, two friends, decide to put an end to the misery of couples by starting a love hotel. However, the local political group is not in favour of their venture.
Suraj, a police officer, is assigned to arrest his friend Yash, whose father runs an illegal business. He must now persuade his friend to make his father change his ways to avoid the consequences.
Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.
